verdict.rationale: Netlify's own docs tout 'Automatic HTTPS and DDoS protection' (netlify-docs-9), implying safeguards against traffic-driven costs, but community reports directly contradict this: one user received a $104k bill after a DDoS event with Netlify only offering a discount to ~$5k, and others describe being blindsided by bandwidth/user-based billing changes and migrating away in response.
